ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the red-tailed hawk population decreases, what will most likely happen to the marmot population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, red-tailed hawk is located in the upper right, and marmot is located on the right side, somewhat lower middle. There is an arrow in the diagram from marmot to red-tailed hawk, indicating that the red-tailed hawk obtains energy from marmot, that is, the red-tailed hawk preys on marmot. Reasoning: The question asks if the number of red-tailed hawk decreases, how the number of marmot is most likely to change. Because the red-tailed hawk is a predator of marmot, a decrease in red-tailed hawks would reduce the predation pressure on marmot, so marmot are more likely to survive and reproduce more. Therefore marmot population would increase.
